source: draft-meunier-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-02 Appendix E.2.3 (EdDSA Using Curve edwards25519, Signed directory response), 18 August 2026. https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-meunier-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-02.txt
note: A directory possession proof (draft Appendix B): a response-side signature over @authority;req from the fetching request and the response Content-Digest, tag http-message-signatures-directory. draft-02 makes the proof optional for directly resolved directories; this vector gates the response-side signature base builder, it is not required on fetches.
